format: Studio / Custom events: 'Under review' presentation for entrants
requirement: DESIGN REQUIREMENT, NOT IMPLEMENTED: where practical, show entrants of Studio/Custom events an 'Under review' status for a result that was published and is now hidden, instead of silently removing it, without revealing the reason or the corrected values before republication.
enforcement_point: None. No implementation authorized; see the OD-22 record for states and wording.
interpretation_notes: Unimplemented scope. Today the public round reader returns a generic under_review notice; the entrant reader does not. No claim of body compliance.
decision_refs: OD-22 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A for future WSDC support, with UCWDC correction-authority restrictions; retrospective audit PR #795)
